topics.title: 了: completed action and change of state
topics.scope: Verbal 了 after the verb for a completed/bounded action (esp. with quantified objects), sentence-final 了 for a new situation, double 了 (已经…了 so far), 了 in sequences (吃了饭就走), when 了 must NOT appear (habitual, 没 negation, stative verbs, after 是/在/觉得, with 每天/常常), 太…了, 不…了 (no longer).

topics.title: 过: experience
topics.scope: Experiential 过 (have ever done), 没…过, 过 vs 了 (experience vs specific completed event), 过 with 次/遍, V过了 (already done routine action), question forms (…过吗 / …过没有), 从来没…过.

topics.title: 着: ongoing state
topics.scope: 着 for a continuing state after the verb (门开着, 穿着), V1着V2 manner (站着说, 笑着回答), 着 vs 在 (state vs action in progress), existential Place+V着+N (墙上挂着画), 着 in imperatives (拿着, 听着), 没…着, verbs that do not take 着.

topics.title: 在 / 正在 / 呢: action in progress
topics.scope: 在/正在 + verb for action in progress, sentence-final 呢 for ongoing, 正在…呢, negation with 没(在), progressive in the past (昨天你来的时候我正在…), 在 as progressive vs 在 as location coverb vs 在 as main verb, verbs that cannot be progressive (知道, 是, 有, 喜欢).

topics.title: 要…了 / 快…了 / 就要…了: about to happen
topics.scope: 要…了, 快…了, 快要…了, 就要…了; which of them accept a specific time word (only 就要…了: 明天就要…了), 快…了 with nouns/numbers (快十点了), obligatory final 了, contrast with plain 要 (want/will) and with completed 了.

topics.title: 是…的: stressing when, where, how
topics.scope: 是…的 to stress time/place/manner/agent/purpose of a KNOWN past event; 的 after the verb or after the object (我是在北京学的中文); omitting 是 in affirmatives but never in negatives (不是…的); contrast with 了 (new event vs detail of known event); questions 你是怎么来的?; not used for future events.

topics.title: 的 / 得 / 地
topics.scope: Choosing among 的 (modifier + noun), 得 (verb/adj + complement of degree or potential), 地 (adverbial + verb). Typical frames: adj+的+noun, clause+的+noun, verb+得+adj, adj+得+clause, 高兴地说, reduplicated adj+地, 得 after verb-object needs verb repetition. Each item must be decidable from syntax.

topics.title: 的: when to use it and when to drop it
topics.scope: 的 for possession and modification; dropping 的 with close kin/institutions (我妈妈, 我们学校), with single-syllable adjectives (好朋友, 新书) vs 很+adj+的 (很好的朋友); relative clauses before the noun (我昨天买的书); 的 nominalisation (红的, 我的, 吃的); number/measure before or after the 的-phrase; no 的 between measure word and noun.

topics.title: Result complements
topics.scope: Verb + result: 完 好 到 见 懂 会 错 对 清楚 干净 住 开 掉 走 光 着(zháo) 给 在 成. Choosing the right result for the meaning (看见 vs 看到 vs 看懂 vs 看完), negation with 没 (没听懂, not 不听懂 for a past event), object placement after the whole V+R, 了 after V+R, question forms (…了没有).

topics.title: Directional complements
topics.scope: Simple 来/去 after verbs of motion (进来, 回去), compound (走进来, 拿出去, 站起来, 坐下来), object placement (place objects go before 来/去: 回家去, 走进教室来; things may go before or after), 把 with directionals, extended meanings: 起来 (begin / judging: 看起来), 下去 (continue), 出来 (figure out/produce), 下来 (settle, record), 上 (attach/achieve), 过来/过去.

topics.title: Potential complements: can / cannot manage
topics.scope: V得R / V不R (看得懂/看不懂, 听得见/听不见, 买得到/买不到, 进得去/进不去, 想不起来), fixed forms (来得及/来不及, 吃得下, 买不起, 对不起, 受不了, V不了/V得了), potential vs 能 (不能进去 = not allowed vs 进不去 = unable), potential vs degree complement (写得好 ambiguous forms: questions 写得好写不好 vs 写得好不好), object placement, question forms.

topics.title: Degree complements with 得
topics.scope: V+得+(很)adj to evaluate how an action is done (跑得很快); with an object: repeat the verb or front the object (他说中文说得很好 / 他中文说得很好), never V+O+得; negation goes after 得 (说得不好, not 不说得好); questions (说得怎么样 / 说得好不好); adj+得+很/不得了/要命; contrast with adverbial 地 and with 很+adj predicates.

topics.title: Duration and frequency
topics.scope: Duration after the verb (学了两年), with object: V+了+duration+(的)+O or repeat verb (学中文学了两年), pronoun/person object before duration (等了他半天), double 了 for still ongoing (学了两年了), negative: duration BEFORE the verb (两年没见), 次/遍/趟/回/下 after the verb, place/pronoun object ordering (去过两次北京 / 去过北京两次 / 见过他一次), time-when before verb vs duration after.

topics.title: Core word order
topics.scope: Subject + time + place + manner/with-whom + verb + object; time and place never at the end; adverbs (也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直) after the subject and before the verb; 也 before 都 before 不; modifiers before the noun; question words stay in place (no fronting); topic-comment fronting; 先…再; position of 一起, 跟…一起.

topics.title: Coverbs (prepositions)
topics.scope: Choosing and placing 在 给 跟 和 对 向 往 从 到 离 为 替 用 坐 朝. Coverb phrase goes BEFORE the verb (我在家吃饭, 给他打电话, 跟朋友见面, 对我很好, 从北京到上海, 离这儿很远, 往左拐, 向他学习, 为你高兴, 用筷子吃); 从 vs 离; 对 vs 跟 vs 给; 往 vs 向; negation and adverbs before the coverb; post-verbal 在/到/给 with placement verbs (放在, 送到, 寄给).

topics.title: 把 construction
topics.scope: S + 把 + definite object + V + something more (result/direction/了/在+place/给+person/reduplication); a bare verb is not allowed; obligatory 把 with 放在/送到/翻译成/当作/交给; negation and modals BEFORE 把 (没把, 不要把, 可以把); verbs that cannot take 把 (是 有 喜欢 知道 觉得 来 去, perception without result); indefinite objects resist 把; 把 vs plain SVO.

topics.title: 被 passive
topics.scope: Receiver + 被 (+ agent) + V + result/了; agent may be dropped after 被 but not after 叫/让; negation and modals before 被 (没被, 不会被); needs a result or 了 after the verb; colloquial 叫/让; unmarked passives (作业写完了, 饭做好了) where 被 is unnatural; 把 ⇄ 被 conversion.

topics.title: Comparisons
topics.scope: A 比 B + adj (no 很: 比他很高 is wrong; use 更/还 or a quantity after: 高一点儿 / 高得多 / 高三厘米 / 大两岁); negative with 没有 (A 没有 B 高) vs 不比; A 跟/和 B 一样 (+adj), 不一样; 最; 更; 比 with verbs + degree complement (他比我跑得快 / 他跑得比我快); 越来越; 比较 as adverb; 不如.

topics.title: 有 / 在 / 是 and existence sentences
topics.scope: Place + 有 + indefinite thing (桌子上有一本书), definite thing + 在 + place (书在桌子上), place + 是 + thing (identifying what occupies it), location nouns (上 下 里 外 旁边 前面 后面 中间 对面 附近) and when 里/上 is needed (在桌子上, but 在北京 without 里), Place + V着/V了 + indefinite N (门口站着一个人, 来了一位客人), negation 没有 / 不在.

topics.title: 连…都 / 也: even
topics.scope: 连 + focus + 都/也 + predicate; focus can be subject, fronted object, verb (连看都没看), 一 + measure (连一个人都没有); 都/也 is obligatory; position of the fronted object before the verb; negation follows 都/也; 一点儿也不 / 一点儿都没 as the related 'not even a little' pattern.

topics.title: 不 vs 没
topics.scope: 不 for habits, present/future, willingness, adjectives, 是/在/知道/认识 and modals (不会, 不能, 不想); 没(有) for past non-occurrence, not-yet, 有 (never 不有), with 过, and progressive; 没 never with 了 for completed action; 不 vs 没 change of meaning (他不来 vs 他没来); result complements negated with 没, potential with 不; 别 / 不要 / 不用 for commands.

topics.title: 会 / 能 / 可以
topics.scope: 会 learned skill and predicted future (会下雨); 能 ability/capacity under circumstances, physical possibility, quantity achieved (能吃三碗); 可以 permission and feasibility; negatives 不会 / 不能 / 不可以 and that 'may I?' is answered 不行/不能; 能 for recovered or specific ability; 会 + 的 certainty; 很会/很能; overlap cases must be excluded by context.

topics.title: 就 vs 才
topics.scope: 就 = earlier/sooner/easier than expected, 才 = later/harder than expected (八点就来了 / 八点才来); 了 appears with 就 but not with 才; 才 = only (才三岁, 才五块钱); 就 = right then / precisely (我就是, 这儿就是); 一…就; 只有…才, 只要…就, 如果…就; 就 = only (就他一个人); position after subject and time.

topics.title: 又 / 再 / 还
topics.scope: 又 = again, already happened (他又来了) or sure-to-recur; 再 = again, not yet happened (明天再来, 再说一遍); 还 = still / in addition / again in questions and with modals (还想去, 还要一个); 先…再; 再也不 / 再也没; 又…又; 还是 (still); 还没…呢; 再 + adj (再大一点儿); position relative to modals (还想 but 想再).

topics.title: 都 and 也
topics.scope: 都 after the things it totals (我们都去; 这些书我都看了: object must be fronted for 都 to cover it); 也 after the subject, before 都 (我们也都去); 也/都 before 不/没 and partial vs total negation (都不 vs 不都); 每…都, 什么/谁/哪儿…都, 一点儿也不; 也 never sentence-initial or sentence-final; 都 for 'already' (都十二点了).

topics.title: 二 vs 两
topics.scope: 两 before measure words and for quantities (两个, 两本, 两天, 两点, 两年, 两块钱, 两次, 两位); 二 for counting, digits, ordinals and dates (第二, 二月, 二号, 二楼, 十二, 二十, 零点二, 二分之一); 两 or 二 before 百 (both), 两 before 千/万/亿 by preference; 二 in 十二个, 二十个 even before measures; 两 = a couple (过两天); 俩 = 两个.

topics.title: 还是 vs 或者
topics.scope: 还是 for 'or' in questions offering a choice (你喝茶还是咖啡?) and in embedded questions (我不知道他去还是不去); 或者 for 'or' in statements (周六或者周日都行); 还是 = 'had better' (还是坐地铁吧) and 'still'; 无论/不管…还是…都; no 吗 with 还是 questions.

topics.title: 刚 / 刚刚 vs 刚才
topics.scope: 刚才 is a time noun (a moment ago): can stand before the subject, modify a noun (刚才的事), go with 没/不 negation and with final 了; 刚/刚刚 is an adverb (only just): after the subject, directly before the verb, compatible with a time span (刚来两天), usually no final 了, can be followed by 就; relative recency of 刚 (去年刚毕业) vs 刚才 limited to minutes ago.

topics.title: 一点儿 vs 有点儿
topics.scope: 有点儿 + adj/verb = 'a bit (too)', usually for something undesired (有点儿贵, 有点儿累); adj + 一点儿 = 'a bit more', comparison or request (便宜一点儿, 快一点儿); 一点儿 + noun = a little of (喝一点儿水); 一点儿也不/都不 + adj = not at all; 有(一)点儿 before the adjective vs 一点儿 after it; 一下 vs 一点儿; 一些.

topics.title: 想 / 要 / 想要 / 愿意 / 得(děi)
topics.scope: 想 = would like to / think of / miss; 要 = want firmly, going to, need to, must; 不想 vs 不要 (don't want vs don't!) vs 不用 (need not: the negative of 要/得 'must'); 得(děi) must, negative 不用 not 不得; 想要 + noun/verb; 愿意 willing; 要 for ordering (我要一杯咖啡); 要 for time needed (要两个小时); 应该; 打算.

topics.title: 以前 / 以后 / 的时候 / 后来 / 然后
topics.scope: X + 以前/以后/的时候 come AFTER the clause or time amount they attach to (吃饭以前, 三年以后, 上课的时候); 以后 (after/future) vs 后来 (afterwards, past only) vs 然后 (and then, next step); 以前 vs 从前 vs 之前; 时候 vs 时间; 什么时候 vs 多长时间; 先…然后…; 最近; 刚才/现在/马上 ordering before the verb.

topics.title: Sentence-final particles
topics.scope: 吗 yes/no question (never with a question word, A-not-A or 还是); 呢 follow-up question (你呢?), wh-question softener, ongoing state, 还没…呢, 才…呢; 吧 suggestion, mild command, presumption seeking agreement (你是老师吧?); 啊 and its warmth/exclamation; 嘛 obviousness; 的 assurance (会好的); 了 change of state; 呗; choosing by speaker intent given in the English.

topics.title: Question forms
topics.scope: 吗 vs A-not-A (去不去, 有没有, 是不是, 喜不喜欢) vs 还是 choice vs question words (谁 什么 哪 哪儿 怎么 怎么样 为什么 几 多少 多+adj 什么时候) left in place; 几 vs 多少; 怎么 vs 怎么样 vs 为什么; 多长/多大/多远; tag questions (好吗, 对不对, 是不是); 呢 with question words; question words as indefinites (什么都, 谁也不, 没什么); rhetorical 不是…吗.

topics.title: Measure words in sentences
topics.scope: Number/这/那/每/几/哪 + measure + noun; frequent classifiers: 个 本 张 条 只 件 辆 位 杯 瓶 碗 块 双 家 间 把 支 台 部 棵 朵 封 首 节 门 层 座 种 些 套 份 口 头 匹 片 顿 场 次 遍 趟; choosing by noun class inside a full sentence; 一些/一点儿 take no other measure; no measure with 天/年 (两天, 三年) but 两个月/两个星期/两个小时; 位 politeness; 这本书 not 这书 in standard usage.

topics.title: Separable verbs
topics.scope: Verb-object compounds: 见面 睡觉 结婚 毕业 帮忙 生气 洗澡 游泳 跑步 唱歌 跳舞 聊天 上课 上班 请假 吃饭 说话 散步 道歉 打架 担心 出差 理发 开会 考试 放假 离婚 握手 鼓掌. They take no further object (跟他见面, not 见面他; 帮他的忙 / 给他帮忙); 了/过/duration/次 go INSIDE (见过面, 睡了八个小时觉, 洗了一个澡, 结过两次婚); reduplicate only the verb (散散步, 聊聊天); 生我的气; degree complement repeats the verb (唱歌唱得很好).

topics.title: Paired connectors
topics.scope: 因为…所以, 虽然…但是/可是, 不但…而且/还, 如果/要是…(的话)…就, 只要…就, 只有…才, 一…就, 一边…一边, 又…又, 既…又/也, 先…再/然后, 除了…(以外)…都/还/也, 无论/不管…都, 即使/就算…也, 越…越, 越来越, 不是…而是, 不是…就是, 要么…要么, 既然…就, 尽管…还是, 为了, 由于…因此; which adverb (就/才/都/也/还) pairs with which opener, and that it sits after the second subject.

topics.title: Reduplication and V 一下
topics.scope: Verb reduplication for brief/tentative action: 看看, 看一看, 看了看 (past), 休息休息 (ABAB), separable 散散步 (AAB); V + 一下 as equivalent; not with 正在/着/过, not with result complements or duration; adjective reduplication AA的 (大大的), AABB (高高兴兴), ABAB for compound colour-type (雪白雪白), no 很 before reduplicated adjectives; 慢慢地 + verb.

topics.title: Numbers, dates, clock time and money in sentences
topics.scope: Large-to-small order: 年月日 星期 上午/下午 点 分; 号 vs 日; 点/分/刻/半/差; 两点 not 二点; 零 inside numbers (一百零五), 万/亿 units; 块/毛/分 and 元; 多 placement (十多个 vs 三个多月), 左右, 几 for small unknown numbers, 第 ordinals and when 第 is dropped (二月, 三楼); 半 (半个小时, 一个半小时, 两天半); phone/room numbers digit by digit with 幺; 岁; percentages 百分之; fractions.

topics.title: Tone changes: 不, 一 and third tones
topics.scope: 不 is bù but bú before a 4th tone (bú shì, bú qù); 一 is yī alone, in counting and as ordinal/last digit, yí before a 4th tone (yí gè, yí yàng), yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (yì tiān, yì nián, yì qǐ); two 3rd tones: the first becomes 2nd (nǐ hǎo -> ní hǎo), three in a row grouped by phrase; half-third tone before other tones; neutral tone after reduplication and in particles. GUIDE ONLY: drilled by a generator, no authored items.

topics.title: Near-synonyms: two words, one English translation
topics.scope: Pairs and triples that English translates the same way: 知道 / 认识 / 了解 (know); 再 / 又 (again: future vs. already happened) and 还 (still, also); 以后 / 后来 / 然后 (afterwards); 帮 / 帮助 / 帮忙 (help: object placement, 帮忙 is separable); 以为 / 认为 / 觉得 (think: mistaken belief vs. judgement); 参观 / 访问 / 看望 (visit a place vs. a person); 合适 / 适合 (adjective vs. verb); 突然 / 忽然; 经验 / 经历; 发现 / 发明; 的时候 / 时 / 以前; 旅行 / 旅游; 明白 / 懂 / 清楚; 通过 / 经过; 关于 / 对于; 一点儿 / 有点儿 is covered elsewhere and must not be used here.

topics.title: Verb and object pairs: which verb goes with which noun
topics.scope: Fixed verb-object and verb-noun pairs where English uses another verb: 打 (电话, 篮球, 车, 针, 伞, 工), 踢足球 / 打篮球 / 弹钢琴 / 拉小提琴 / 下棋; 穿 (衣服, 鞋) / 戴 (帽子, 眼镜, 手表, 口罩) / 系 (领带); 坐 (车, 飞机) / 骑 (自行车, 马) / 开 (车, 会, 灯, 玩笑) / 乘; 看 (病, 书, 电视, 医生) / 读 / 念; 吃药 / 喝汤 / 抽烟; 做 (饭, 作业, 梦, 生意) / 干 / 搞 / 办 (手续, 签证, 事); 上 (课, 班, 网, 大学) / 下 (课, 班, 雨, 雪, 决心); 发 (烧, 邮件, 短信, 工资) / 寄 (信, 包裹) / 送; 提 (问题, 意见, 要求) / 回答问题 / 解决问题; 照相 / 拍照 / 拍电影; 洗澡 / 刷牙 / 梳头; 过 (生日, 年, 马路) / 度 (假); 起 (名字, 床) / 取; 生 (气, 病, 孩子); 留 (作业, 言, 学). Adjective-noun pairs too: 浓 / 淡 (茶, 颜色), 大 / 小 (雨, 风, 声), 重 / 轻 (病, 伤), 深 / 浅 (颜色, 印象).

topics.title: Look-alike characters: one stroke apart
topics.scope: Choosing the right character among look-alikes inside a word, where the sentence fixes the word: 己 / 已 / 巳; 未 / 末; 买 / 卖; 人 / 入 / 八; 大 / 太 / 犬 / 天 / 夫; 日 / 目 / 白 / 自; 土 / 士; 干 / 千 / 于; 午 / 牛; 牛 / 半; 我 / 找; 住 / 往 / 注 / 主; 请 / 清 / 情 / 晴 / 睛 / 精; 那 / 哪; 他 / 她 / 它 / 地 / 池; 问 / 间 / 闻 / 们 / 闪; 休 / 体; 快 / 块 / 筷; 爱 / 受; 很 / 根 / 跟 / 狠; 外 / 处; 乐 / 东 / 车; 泪 / 汨; 喝 / 渴; 蓝 / 篮; 洒 / 酒; 贝 / 见; 刀 / 力; 鸟 / 乌; 今 / 令; 拔 / 拨; 辩 / 辨 / 辫; 候 / 侯; 既 / 即; 竟 / 竞; 历 / 厉; 练 / 炼; 须 / 需; 象 / 像 / 向. Cloze options are the look-alike characters (or the word written with each); judge items show a sentence with one wrong look-alike. Every item's why names the difference (stroke, radical) and a way to remember it.

topics.title: 成语: four-character idioms in the right situation
topics.scope: The common four-character idioms a learner meets up to HSK 5, chosen by the situation the sentence describes, and used with the right grammar (as predicate, attributive with 的, adverbial with 地): 马马虎虎, 乱七八糟, 一路平安, 不好意思 (not a chengyu: exclude), 入乡随俗, 半途而废, 画蛇添足, 对牛弹琴, 井底之蛙, 守株待兔, 亡羊补牢, 自相矛盾, 一举两得, 一见钟情, 三心二意, 七上八下, 九牛一毛, 十全十美, 百闻不如一见 (longer sayings are allowed when common), 千方百计, 万事如意, 莫名其妙, 理所当然, 无所谓, 不可思议, 迫不及待, 津津有味, 兴高采烈, 聚精会神, 全力以赴, 一丝不苟, 实事求是, 废寝忘食, 脱口而出, 恍然大悟, 小心翼翼, 无论如何, 讨价还价, 各种各样, 自言自语, 一模一样, 丢三落四, 手忙脚乱, 张冠李戴, 熟能生巧, 入乡随俗. Distractors are other idioms of similar register whose meaning does not fit; judge items test wrong meaning or wrong grammatical use. Levels here are relative to the topic: 1 = everyday idioms (马马虎虎, 乱七八糟), 3 = literary ones.

topics.title: 多音字: one character, more than one reading
topics.scope: Characters whose reading depends on the word: 行 (xíng / háng), 长 (cháng / zhǎng), 得 (de / dé / děi), 了 (le / liǎo), 还 (hái / huán), 重 (zhòng / chóng), 乐 (lè / yuè), 觉 (jué / jiào), 便 (biàn / pián), 都 (dōu / dū), 为 (wèi / wéi), 教 (jiāo / jiào), 好 (hǎo / hào), 少 (shǎo / shào), 数 (shù / shǔ), 种 (zhǒng / zhòng), 发 (fā / fà), 干 (gān / gàn), 看 (kàn / kān), 空 (kōng / kòng), 难 (nán / nàn), 相 (xiāng / xiàng), 处 (chù / chǔ), 调 (diào / tiáo), 当 (dāng / dàng), 倒 (dǎo / dào), 差 (chà / chā / chāi), 假 (jiǎ / jià), 间 (jiān / jiàn), 着 (zhe / zháo / zhuó), 只 (zhǐ / zhī), 地 (dì / de), 的 (de / dí / dì), 和 (hé / huo), 没 (méi / mò), 要 (yào / yāo), 应 (yīng / yìng), 中 (zhōng / zhòng), 转 (zhuǎn / zhuàn), 背 (bèi / bēi). The drill is generated from a reviewed word table (data/grammar_drills/zh/words/polyphones.json): a word is shown and the reading of one character is chosen. The guide teaches the rule of thumb for each character: which reading goes with which meaning.
